parameters.query:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT id, parqueadero_usuario_id, es_principal
  FROM public.parqueadero_vehiculos
  WHERE id = $1::bigint AND activo = TRUE
), successor AS (
  SELECT pv.id
  FROM public.parqueadero_vehiculos pv
  JOIN target t ON t.parqueadero_usuario_id = pv.parqueadero_usuario_id
  WHERE pv.activo = TRUE AND pv.id <> t.id
  ORDER BY pv.es_principal DESC, pv.creado_en, pv.id
  LIMIT 1
), retired AS (
  UPDATE public.parqueadero_vehiculos pv
  SET activo = FALSE, es_principal = FALSE, actualizado_en = now()
  FROM target t
  WHERE pv.id = t.id
  RETURNING pv.id, t.es_principal
), promoted AS (
  UPDATE public.parqueadero_vehiculos pv
  SET es_principal = TRUE, actualizado_en = now()
  FROM retired r
  WHERE r.es_principal = TRUE
    AND pv.id = (SELECT id FROM successor)
  RETURNING pv.id
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT TRUE FROM retired LIMIT 1), FALSE) AS success,
  (SELECT id::int FROM retired LIMIT 1) AS id,
  (SELECT id::int FROM promoted LIMIT 1) AS "promotedVehicleId",
  CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retired) THEN 'El vehículo no existe o ya fue retirado.' ELSE NULL END AS error,
  CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retired) THEN 404 ELSE 200 END AS "statusCode";
